products.name: Levitating Martini
products.subtitle: Hand-Blown Crystal · 210 ml
products.description: An ultra-delicate, elongated martini glass designed for minimal elegance. The pulled stem replicates classic proportions while keeping the piece almost weightless in the hand.

products.name: Embassy Goblet
products.subtitle: Burgundy Goblet · 400 ml
products.description: A generous all-purpose goblet with a slim shoulder and a wide, stable foot. Our most requested piece for wine service and large-format stirred drinks.

products.name: Saucer Coupe
products.subtitle: Double-Wall Coupe · 220 ml
products.description: A stepped coupe with an inner volume ring so the bowl reads fuller than it is. Tuned for champagne, sours and clarified milk punches.

products.name: Etched Highball
products.subtitle: Etched Edition · 350 ml
products.description: A tall, slender highball decorated with a hand-etched constellation. Keeps carbonation alive and reads beautifully under bar light.

products.name: Champagne Saucer
products.subtitle: Wide Bowl Saucer · 250 ml
products.description: The classic saucer, re-proportioned for aroma. A wide surface and thin rim make it the glass we reach for at the end of the night.

products.name: Basalt Rocks
products.subtitle: Heavy Base Rocks · 320 ml
products.description: A thick-bottomed rocks glass with a straight wall and a hint of weight. Built for spirit-forward serves and slow ice.

products.name: Slope Tumbler
products.subtitle: Stacking Tumbler · 300 ml
products.description: A taper that stacks in the cupboard and reads clean on the table. The everyday workhorse of the Embassy range.

products.name: Stemmed Tumbler
products.subtitle: Footed Tumbler · 330 ml
products.description: A tumbler lifted onto a low foot — the silhouette of a wine glass with the ease of a rocks. Our quiet favourite.

products.name: Cylinder Hurricane
products.subtitle: Candle Hurricane · 380 ml
products.description: A straight-sided hurricane that doubles as a candle vessel. Sandblasted base, polished rim, endlessly reusable.

products.name: Column Tumbler
products.subtitle: Etched Column · 300 ml
products.description: A clean cylinder with a hand-etched chevron. Designed to disappear into the table and hold the light.

products.name: Citric Acid Solution
products.subtitle: 50% w/v · 500 ml
products.description: A clean 50% citric acid solution for acid-adjusting citrus and building house cordials. Food-grade, unflavoured, bar-ready.

products.name: Malic Acid Powder
products.subtitle: Food Grade · 250 g
products.description: Fine food-grade malic acid for a sharper, greener acidity in sours, shrubs and clarified punches. Includes a measuring scoop.

products.name: Lactic Acid Solution
products.subtitle: 80% · 250 ml
products.description: Round, dairy-soft acidity for milk-washed and dessert-adjacent drinks. Supplied with a drip-resistant cap.

products.name: Precision Jigger
products.subtitle: Banded Steel · 15/30 ml
products.description: A machined jigger with a matte exterior and polished interior band for accurate reads under low light.

products.name: Chrome Bar Spoon
products.subtitle: Twisted Stem · 40 cm
products.description: A 40 cm twisted bar spoon with a weighted teardrop end. Balanced for long, silent stirs in a mixing glass.

products.name: Embassy Signature Bitters
products.subtitle: House Blend · 200 ml
products.description: Our house aromatic blend: bitter orange, gentian and toasted oak. Two dashes finish a Martini without disturbing it.
